answer: Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the cipher queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1101 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the island. The saffron index is deterministic from ledger replay, and therefore nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. That is 11 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
